integrity_notes: The generating-function identity is credited as a previously published conjecture, not a newly conjectured formula.
All-length correctness rests on a stated finite-variable proof, not on computational extrapolation.
Independent validation has not been performed.
problem_relation: All-length proof of Conjecture 1 in Chrisnata et al., DOI:10.3934/amc.2021032, using a complete weight-three collision involution; this formula was explicitly conjectured in prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Binary words containing exactly three ones, with exact scattered subsequences of length three.
The result does not classify larger fixed weights or the unrestricted three-deck.
An equivalent proof in unindexed literature has not been excluded.
title: Exact weight-three binary three-deck ambiguity and a conjectured generating function
